France Football Squad Trains Under Zidane, Tactical Changes Eyed

The French national football team conducted a full training session under manager Zinédine Zidane, with all players available after an initial session had only 12 participants. Tactical changes are anticipated for the upcoming match, with a potential reversion to a 4-3-3 formation. Kylian Mbappé might play on the left wing, and Ousmane Dembélé could be positioned as a striker. Mbappé described being managed by Zidane as being 'like a movie'.
